frontier: RP-B3-T1 — Frozen-DP6 Named-Library Standard-Cell PPA Calibration
purpose: Replace remaining full-DP6 ASIC PPA UNKNOWN coefficients with a reproducible technology-calibrated research artifact.
minimum_required_inputs: Frozen DP6 RTL/netlist mechanically derived from existing frozen semantics and parity-bound to canonical vectors, or explicit authority to generate that research RTL/netlist without changing DP6.
Exactly one named legally accessible standard-cell library/PDK with timing/power characterization and explicit process/voltage/corner.
Exactly one synthesis + STA + power flow capable of consuming the frozen RTL/netlist and named library.
Exactly one named memory-interface/controller/PHY/package model with provenance sufficient to state area/power/latency/bandwidth; procurement cost may remain UNKNOWN if not evidenced.
fail_closed_conditions: RTL/netlist cannot be proven parity-equivalent to frozen DP6.
Library/PDK license or provenance is unclear.
PPA flow cannot bind timing and power to an explicit technology/corner.
Memory/package values require invented prices or undocumented scaling.
Any implementation change would alter consensus semantics.
